latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Tavily Search skill.

- Provides AI-optimized web search via the Tavily API, returning concise, relevant results.
- Supports customizable search options: result count, deep search, topic (general/news), and date filtering for news.
- Allows extraction of clean content from any URL.
- Requires a TAVILY_API_KEY.
- Designed specifically for integration with AI agents and workflows.
